info.title: Investran: Data Import
info.description: Flexible, query like access to Investran data and processing data using jobs. This API includes all the methods necessary to upload file, import(save/update/delete/get) job and process(validate/load/cancel/feedback) the job. Some of the common actions are : Upload a file and get the file details, Save job, update job, delete job, get job using the file id, Schedule a process for data validation, data storage, cancel a process, get the process information and provide feedback for a specific process.

post.description: In order to properly create a Data Import Job a collection of mappings must be provided. Mappings are the association between Excel file columns and Investran entities. Each Excel file sheet that is mapped corresponds to an Entity Type. Each column within a sheet that is mapped corresponds to a property of the Entity Type. Any non mapped sheet or column will be ignored and not processed. Examples: Mapping one sheet to an entity: "fileSheets": [ { "name": "My investors", "entityName": "Investor", "mappings": [ ... ] } ] Mapping one column to a property: "mappings": [ "importField": { "name": "name", "fieldType": "default", "typeDescription": "Import Field" }, "columnName": "Investor Name" ]

get.summary: Retrieves metadata information for a specific entity used in data import operations.
get.description:
This endpoint provides detailed metadata information for a specific entity type that is supported for data import operations.
The metadata includes information about the entity's properties, field types, validation rules, and other relevant configuration details
that are necessary for creating proper data import mappings.

The metadata structure returned can be used to:
- Understand the available properties for an entity
- Determine field types and validation requirements
- Build dynamic UI components for mapping configuration
- Validate data import job configurations

The entity name must correspond to one of the supported entities in the system. Use the /entities endpoint to retrieve
a list of all available entity names.

Example request:

    GET /metadata/Investor

Groups field contains all the keygroups to match them each other. You can also find every group of the entity to be mapped.		
KeyGroups field contains the real required fields. These parameters are used to check if the sheet should be green, yellow, or red.		
RequiredFields only fail when you run the job, includes required lookups and UDFs. It throws an error indicating that a UDF or a lookup must be mapped.
